2608.12593.title: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
2608.12593.paper_summary: Discovery---formulating novel generalizations---is a central part of the scientific process. Despite its importance, there is a gap in the current AI benchmark landscape, with few benchmarks directly probing the capacity for discovering new knowledge with experimentation in controlled environments where the objective is unknown. To address this gap, we release a new benchmark: DiG-bench (Discovery in Games). DiG-bench consists of a set of 70 independent games. Each game is encoded as a short string and has unique transformation rules that must be discovered through interaction and experimentation. The levels of the game present a series of challenges to test whether the rules have been discovered, where the win conditions for each level are also unknown. We provide games at seven tiers of difficulty for AI agents. The lowest tier is routinely solvable by multiple models, while the highest tier challenges the best models in agentic harnesses. All 70 games were solved by at least one human on first attempt. A subset of 21 games is released publicly, and the remainder is held private for secure evaluation.
2608.12593.paper_summary_zh: 發現---制定新穎的概括---是科學過程中的核心部分。儘管其重要性不言而喻，但目前的 AI 基準環境中存在一個空白，幾乎沒有基準直接探測在目標未知的控制環境中通過實驗發現新知識的能力。為了解決這一空白，我們推出了一個新的基準：DiG-bench（遊戲中的發現）。DiG-bench 由一組 70 個獨立的遊戲組成。每個遊戲都被編碼為一個短字符串，並具有必須通過互動和實驗來發現的獨特轉換規則。遊戲的關卡呈現一系列挑戰，以測試規則是否已被發現，而每個關卡的獲勝條件也是未知的。我們為 AI 代理提供七個難度級別的遊戲。最低級別的遊戲通常可以被多個模型解決，而最高級別則挑戰最優秀的模型在代理駕馭下的表現。所有 70 個遊戲在第一次嘗試時至少有一位人類成功解決。21 個遊戲的子集已公開發布，其餘部分則保持私密以進行安全評估。
